ubuntu-latest sandbox probe — RAW CAPTURED OUTPUT
=================================================

WHAT THIS IS
  The verbatim output of the temporary `.github/workflows/linux-sandbox-probe.yml`
  workflow (PLAN-ISSUE-020 TASK-001), answering ISSUE-020's re-probe list on a
  REAL GitHub Actions Linux runner. The 2026-07-27 spike ran against Docker
  Desktop's LinuxKit kernel, which compiles in neither AppArmor nor Landlock, so
  its two decisive questions were unmeasurable there and any container-derived
  answer would have been a false negative. These are the measured values.

PROVENANCE
  runner image label   ubuntu-24.04, Image Version 20260720.247.2 (`ubuntu-latest`)
  operating system     Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS (Noble Numbat)
  kernel               6.17.0-1020-azure
  runner user          runner, uid 1001, gid 1001 (unprivileged)
  date (UTC)           2026-07-28T13:44:10Z
  repository           github.com/backstop-ai/backstop-core (private)
  branch               probe/linux-sandbox
  commit               0c075d7
  workflow run URL     https://github.com/backstop-ai/backstop-core/actions/runs/30364880850
  run conclusion       success (every probe step is `set +e` / `exit 0`; the job
                       succeeding says NOTHING about whether the probes passed —
                       read the per-item exit codes below)

FIDELITY
  Captured with `gh run view 30364880850 --log`. The only transformation applied
  is removal of GitHub's per-line log prefix (`<job>\t<step>\t<ISO timestamp> `)
  and of ANSI colour escapes. No line was reordered, summarized, paraphrased or
  removed. The echoed commands GitHub prints in each ##[group] block are retained,
  so every reported value can be traced to the exact command that produced it.

READ THIS FIRST — THE RESULT CONTRADICTS THE SPIKE'S LEADING CANDIDATE
  1. apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns = 1  (RESTRICTED)
     This is ISSUE-020's item 1, the value the plan says to READ AND NOT ASSUME.
     It is the exact risk the 2026-07-27 spike flagged as the one variable that
     could still break unprivileged `--unshare-user` on a real Ubuntu runner. It
     fired.

  2. EVERY bubblewrap invocation failed — exit 1, all seven of them, including
     both control legs:
         ITEM2_EXIT=1                 corrected spike invocation, /bin/true
         ITEM2B_EXIT=1                same, /bin/echo
         ITEM3_0_BOUND_READ_EXIT=1    POSITIVE CONTROL: read of a BOUND path
         ITEM3_1_UNBOUND_READ_EXIT=1  unbound read
         ITEM3_2_DENIED_NET_EXIT=1    getent under --unshare-net
         ITEM3_3_ALLOWED_NET_EXIT=1   CONTROL LEG: getent WITHOUT --unshare-net
         ITEM3_4_WRITE_EXIT=1         write attempt
         ITEM5_UNSHARE_PID_EXIT=1     --unshare-pid with --proc
     The two failure signatures:
         bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR: Operation not permitted
             (every invocation carrying --unshare-net)
         bwrap: setting up uid map: Permission denied
             (the invocation WITHOUT --unshare-net)
     Both are the same root cause: the user namespace is created but the process
     does not hold privileges within it, which is the AppArmor-restriction
     signature. `unshare -Urn /bin/true` fails identically (ITEM6_UNSHARE_EXIT=1),
     confirming this is a host policy on unprivileged user namespaces and not a
     bwrap defect.

  3. THE ASSERTION TRIPLE IS VACUOUS HERE, NOT PASSING. ITEM3_1 and ITEM3_2 are
     non-zero, which the naive reading calls "denied == PASS". They are non-zero
     because BWRAP NEVER STARTED. The positive control (ITEM3_0, reading a bound
     path, which MUST succeed under a working sandbox) is non-zero too, and the
     control leg ITEM3_3 (which MUST exit 0) is non-zero as well. Read together
     the triple proves the mechanism is unavailable — it does not prove denial.
     This is precisely why the spike specified a triple with a control leg.

  4. bwrap is NOT preinstalled on the runner image (`command -v bwrap` exit 1,
     `bwrap --version` exit 127 before apt). `sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap`
     succeeded and provided bubblewrap 0.9.0 at /usr/bin/bwrap. Installing it is
     therefore necessary but NOT sufficient.

  5. LANDLOCK HAS REAL SIGNAL FOR THE FIRST TIME: LANDLOCK_ABI=7, and the kernel's
     LSM list is lockdown,capability,landlock,yama,apparmor,ima,evm — landlock is
     compiled in AND enabled. The spike recorded ZERO Landlock signal (its ENOSYS
     was a LinuxKit kernel-compile fact). ABI 7 exceeds the ABI 5+ the re-probe
     list expected.

  Consequence: TASK-001's stop-and-escalate condition is met. The mechanism
  contest is a founder-level call and is NOT resolved by this file.

Supporting values:
  unprivileged_userns_clone                 1
  user.max_user_namespaces                  31590
  apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_unconfined 0
  aa-status                                 available, exit 0 both privileged and
                                            unprivileged

cat > /tmp/landlock_abi.c <<'LANDLOCK_C_EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>

#ifndef __NR_landlock_create_ruleset
#define __NR_landlock_create_ruleset 444
#endif
#ifndef LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION
#define LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION (1U << 0)
#endif

int main(void) {
    long abi = syscall(__NR_landlock_create_ruleset, NULL, 0,
                       LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION);
    if (abi < 0) {
        printf("LANDLOCK_ABI=ERROR errno=%d (%s)\n", errno, strerror(errno));
        return 1;
    }
    printf("LANDLOCK_ABI=%ld\n", abi);
    return 0;
}
LANDLOCK_C_EOF
